event_name: Super Grip NHRA Thunder Valley Nationals

pairs.note:
Weather conditions: air temperature 82 degrees, relative humidity 63 percent, barometer 29.82 inches, adjusted
altitude 4,182 feet, track temperature 127 degrees.

Hagan is 8 - 2 against Wilkerson in prior events and this is the first time they have faced each other in a
final round.

Hagan with the starting line advantage and never trailed for the win.  Hagan has cylinders out by half track
and then pitches the blower belt on the top end.  Hagan wins his second Wally this season and 57th of his
career.

Wilkerson is up smoke right at the hit and pedaled it, but was up back up in smoke.
